title: Replaces Upcoming Invoice API methods with the Create Preview Invoice API
summary: We’re removing the GET /v1/invoices/upcoming API in favor of the Create Preview Invoice API. - The Upcoming Invoice API methods are no longer available. - You must pass specific subscription details (subscription, subscription_details.items, schedule, schedule_details.phases, or invoice_items) along with the customer parameter to the Create Preview Invoice API.
migrationNotes: Migrate your integration from GET /v1/invoices/upcoming or GET /v1/invoices/upcoming/lines API methods to use the Create Preview Invoice API, which offers equivalent functionality and parameters.

sources.quote: | [Replaces Upcoming Invoice API methods with the Create Preview Invoice API](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/basil/2025-03-31/invoice-preview-api-deprecations.md) | Billing, Invoicing | Breaking | api |

- The Upcoming Invoice API methods are no longer available.
- You must pass specific subscription details (`subscription`, `subscription_details.items`, `schedule`, `schedule_details.phases`, or `invoice_items`) along with the `customer` parameter to the [Create Preview Invoice API](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/create_preview.md?api-version=2025-03-31.basil).
